head: 16ec447f2c60ddf08a514207963f478bc70c7e09
source_facts: Composition.__init__ normalizes packet.control via evidence_indexes.unlinked_absolute before deriving expected reader paths
unlinked_absolute checks every original component for symlink/junction then calls Path.resolve(strict=True)
The test fixture derives anchor reader strings from its incoming TemporaryDirectory Path without first normalizing that root
Local Windows regression used Python 3.14.6; this GitHub job uses the configured Windows Python 3.13 environment
bounded_diagnosis: Canonical control versus original temporary-root spelling is an uncovered portability boundary. The failing CI did not print both path values, so the exact alias/case expansion in this runner is not claimed as proven.
next_repair_boundary: A separate reviewed change should normalize fixture root identity before constructing bound paths and cover real Windows alias/canonical spellings. Do not weaken production exact path, hash, identity, or link-rejection gates.
